name: Wechsler Adult Intelligence Scale (WAIS)
description: The most widely used adult IQ test, measuring four index scores: Verbal Comprehension, Perceptual Reasoning, Working Memory, and Processing Speed. Administered individually by a trained clinician and normed on large representative samples.
reputation: Gold standard for adult cognitive assessment; used globally in clinical, forensic, and research settings.
notes: Requires trained administrator; ceiling effects for high-ability adults; version (WAIS-IV or V) matters.
